$380M total holdings as of Sept 2, 2026: $90M OpenAI (indirect), $18M Beast Industries, $1M Mythical Games

$122M in cash and stablecoins held in treasury, part of overall ~$380M portfolio

Positions reflect focus on AI, digital identity and creator economy; WLD is ~8.3% of circulating supply
